subject: Pollination Contract Request for Wenatchee Family Orchards
body_text:
Hi there, 

I hope this message finds you well! We would like to proceed with a pollination contract for our blueberry segment again this year. Last year, we used 12 hives for our 10-acre block, and we’d like to maintain the same hive count for the upcoming bloom, anticipated around late April. If possible, we would appreciate a split delivery to help manage the flowering stages more effectively. 

Could you send over a clear contract or order confirmation at your earliest convenience? Thank you!

Best,  
Paul Larsen

subject: Pollination Contract Request for Riverbend Farms
body_text:

Looking forward to your prompt reply!

Denise Jones  
Riverbend Farms LP

subject: Hive Request for Upcoming Season
body_text:
Hi there,

This is William Lynch from Old Mission Growers. We're gearing up for the upcoming season and wanted to discuss our pollination needs across our various sites. We're looking at 150 hives for our apple orchard in Hood River, ideally starting around April 5th and running through May 15th. Additionally, we’ll need 100 hives for our blueberry fields in Salem, starting June 1st and extending through June 25th.

We'd also like to explore the possibility of restructuring our contract for this year to accommodate these changes. It would be great to have a chat about how we can manage these schedules effectively while ensuring optimal pollination for both crops. 

Please let me know your availability for a call this week. Looking forward to your insights!

Best,  
William Lynch  
Old Mission Growers
